I think writing code is still a more effective way to learn than by reading it- especially when it comes to retention. I still find it useful to code by hand when I'm learning a new language/framework/architectural pattern (often still using an LLM as a pair programmer) and then 'graduate' to a more automated process as I become more comfortable. There are different learning styles, but for absolute beginners who have ambitions of becoming serious engineers, I would still recommend writing code by hand to get a solid grasp of fundamentals.
